# Aarav Vaswani — Résumé

> Saints Robotics Vice President · NEEMO Co-Founder · IB Diploma Candidate

[Aarav Vaswani’s guided tour](https://resume-city.vercel.app) covers education, building and repairing robots, leading and teaching, and current work. The city model follows the story as it is read.

[Download the résumé PDF](https://resume-city.vercel.app/resume-aarav-vaswani.pdf)

## Introduction

- [Introduction](https://resume-city.vercel.app/plaza/welcome-plaza): Aarav Vaswani — summary, location, and contact info.

## Education, building, community, and current work

- [Saints Robotics (FRC)](https://resume-city.vercel.app/foundry/robotics-workshop): Saints Robotics — FRC Team. Vice President; Competition Technician; former Electrical Control Systems Officer.
- [NEEMO](https://resume-city.vercel.app/foundry/neemo-hq): Co-Founder of a business focused on long-range RFID tracking of parts within robotics workshops.
- [Interlake High School](https://resume-city.vercel.app/foundry/academic-hall): IB Diploma Candidate — GPA, AP exam scores, and IB Higher Level coursework.
- [Makers Club](https://resume-city.vercel.app/foundry/makers-club): Co-Founder & Officer of a school 3D design/printing club.
- [DECA](https://resume-city.vercel.app/foundry/deca-center): Competitor in entrepreneurship-focused business events, advanced to the State competition.
- [FIRST LEGO League](https://resume-city.vercel.app/foundry/fll-center): Mentor for two FIRST LEGO League teams.

## Interests

Cooking, recreational sports, driving, and video games.
